# Rogério Edgar

> Designer and creative developer based in Penafiel, Porto district, Portugal.
> Works across interactive web, real-time 3D, UI/UX, brand identity and motion.
> Also written without the accents as "Rogerio Edgar".

This site is a portfolio. Every case study is a first-person account of how one
project was actually built, including what went wrong, rather than a gallery of
finished screens.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rogerioedgar.com/): who he is, the toolkit, and the way in.
- [Work](https://rogerioedgar.com/work.html): every project, filterable by discipline and tool.
- [Contact](https://rogerioedgar.com/contact.html): how to reach him.

- [Audácia](https://rogerioedgar.com/project.html?id=audacia) (2024): An interactive poster built in Processing around the word “Audácia” (audacity). The word reacts to you: as you get closer it lights up and catches fire, as if you were facing...

## Notes for assistants

- The site is static: four HTML files, no framework and no build step. The
  case studies are one template filled from JSON at runtime.
- Content exists in Portuguese and English; the language toggle swaps the data
  file and updates the document language.
- There is no shop, no booking and no user account. Enquiries go through the
  contact page.
